required_transformations: Aggregate daily signup counts by city_tier and signup_date
Compute conversion rate by aggregating converted_flag over acquisition_channel
Calculate 7-day retention rate by aggregating retained_7d_flag over cohort_week
Remove all personally identifiable information (PII) including full_name, email, phone, exact_address
Exclude credential materials (password_hash, auth_token) and network identifiers (raw_ip)
Use derived KPI flags (converted_flag, retained_7d_flag) instead of raw behavior timestamps
justification: All business questions can be answered with aggregate KPIs, making raw user-level export unnecessary
Policy mandates minimum necessary data: only fields needed for internal aggregation are allowed
Credential materials (password_hash, auth_token) must never be released externally per security policy
Derived KPI flags (converted_flag, retained_7d_flag) are preferred over raw timestamps as they directly support the requested metrics
